title: Print Shop Custom Job Order & Production Status Tracker
summary: Order workflow application tracking custom print specifications, production queue stages, deadline alerts, and material inventories.
problem: Handling custom printing orders (paper stock, dimensions, lamination, turnaround deadline) through fragmented messages leads to missed print schedules and wrong proof runs.
whatIDid: Built a modular Kanban-style order progress tracker with statuses: Order Received, Proof Approval, In Production, QA Check, Ready for Pickup.
Integrated custom specification inputs (print dimensions, paper gsm, quantity, finish coating, customer rush deadline).
Implemented automated priority sorting flagging rush orders approaching turnaround within 24 hours.
Designed an exportable production summary report for morning workshop briefing.
result: Developed functional web-based tracking dashboard for print shop workflow modeling [INTERNAL SYSTEM DEMO].

media.caption: Kanban board interface showing active production stages and urgent turnaround tags.
